newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: President Wasmosy appoints three new ministers.
newsitem.headline: President Wasmosy appoints three new ministers.

text.p: Paraguay's President Juan Wasmosy appointed three ministers to his cabinet Thursday after defections from his government that stemmed from an internal rift in the ruling Colorado Party.
He appointed Atilio Fernandez interior minister, Vicente Sarubbi education minister and Gustavo Diaz de Vivar integration minister.
Their predecessors resigned this week after talks to agree on a Colorado Party candidate in next year's presidential elections broke down.
The split in the party has produced a rift between Wasmosy's faction, which supports the candidacy of Finance Secretary Carlos Facetti, and the backers of Luis Argana, the party president.
